hp.details: Broken Threshold 35 — the lid splits when the coffin is Broken; the hazard ends when it is Destroyed.

stealth.details: (initiative when the binding-wards wake; the coffin itself sits in plain sight on the dais beneath the mirror)

details.description: A heavy iron sarcophagus bound in black chains, set on the dais beneath the mirror, its sides pierced with finger-width holes. @UUID[Actor.Imi7xJECTa2xz1o6]{Veyrin} can pour through them in mist form to shelter and heal — the “coffin restoration” named on his stat block. Disturb it and the binding-wards wake, flinging iron shards and grasping shadow-chains at anyone close.
details.disable:
@Check[religion|dc:36|name:Unravel the Binding-Wards] or @Check[arcana|dc:36|name:Unravel the Binding-Wards] (master) to unravel the binding-wards and still the coffin (ends the Routine), or @Check[athletics|dc:38|name:Wrench the Lid Wide] to wrench the lid open and expose Veyrin directly. A single hit that drives 25 or more damage past its Hardness staggers the wards: the hazard is dormant until the end of its next turn.

It is an object: Hardness 18 (solid iron; halved to 9 against adamantine, as with the hall's other glass-wards), HP 70, Broken Threshold 35; attacks resolve against AC 30, and it is immune to critical hits and precision damage, so no blow doubles against it. The fighter grinds it down; the party converging — a Disintegrate, a second martial — breaks it in a round or two.

Broken (35 HP): the lid splits. The warded area shrinks to a @Template[square|distance:5], the Routine loses Grasping Chains, and Veyrin within drops from total cover to standard cover (+2 AC) and is concealed through the gap — he can now be targeted on a DC 5 flat check.

Destroyed (0 HP): the sarcophagus breaks open and the hazard ends. If Veyrin is inside, he is spat into the open, @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} until the end of his next turn — the refuge spent.
details.reset: If Veyrin isn't inside and no creature has been in its area for 1 round, the sarcophagus falls dormant until disturbed again.
details.routine:
(2 actions) Fixed in place, the sarcophagus acts on its own initiative each round it is awake. Its wards fill a @Template[square|distance:10] centered on the coffin (a @Template[square|distance:5] once it is Broken).

  • Lash (1 action) Iron shards and shadow-chains erupt across the area. Each creature in it takes @Damage[(2d10+18)[slashing],1d10[void]|options:area-damage]{2d10+18 slashing and 1d10 void} damage (@Check[reflex|dc:35|basic|options:area-effect] save). (Swap the @Damage[1d10[void]]{void} to @Damage[1d10[cold]]{cold} to lean Ice Queen rather than vampire.)
  • Grasping Chains (1 action) Shadow-chains seize one creature in the area: @Check[reflex|dc:35] or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} (escape DC 35).

Veyrin is never affected — the wards are his. Running hot alongside the Queen's Rime? Drop the Routine to the single Lash action.

description.value:
Trigger A creature attacks the sarcophagus, ends its turn within 10 feet of it, or Veyrin retreats inside.

Effect The binding-wards roar to life; the hazard rolls initiative.

The sarcophagus is @UUID[Actor.Imi7xJECTa2xz1o6]{Veyrin}'s refuge — the “coffin restoration” named on his stat block. While the coffin is awake and intact and he is within it in mist form, he has total cover: he cannot be targeted, and his fast healing 15 ticks each round, untouched. He cannot Strike out; emerging into the open costs him an action.

Once the lid is Broken he has only standard cover (+2 AC) and is concealed through the gap (DC 5 flat check to target him). When the coffin is Destroyed the refuge is gone and he is spat into the open.
